page.overview:
Who is Thumper's Handlers?

Thumper's Handlers are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

"To emphasize his threats, Hopper snaps his claws and Thumper appears, yanking against a heavy leash held by two handlers. They have him under control—barely. They better hope he never turns on them."

They only appear during Thumper's introduction, holding a leash behind him.
